camus.songTitle: I Don’t Want to Get Over You
camus.line: I could dress in black and read Camus
stanza: Or I could make a career of being blue
I could dress in black and read Camus
Smoke clove cigarettes and drink vermouth
But I don't want to get over you

camus.line: See him fashion a cap from a page of Camus;
stanza: And Gabriel stands beneath forest and moon
See them shake, and see them loom
See him fashion a cap from a page of Camus;
And see him navigate deftly this side of the blue
